messages:
AlexC: FYI latency spike on pool 'pool-p2-shared' around 2026-03-17T02:14Z. P90 doubled (~600ms -> 1.2s). Traces point at KV cache churn + cuda alloc waits. cc @Marta @RyanK
perf-bot: Automated check: eviction_rate=4.3/s for Redis-KV layer on pool-p2-shared; avg KV lookup 4.8ms -> 12.1ms during window.
Marta: Can you paste the profiler output? I want to see whether kernel selection is switching to slow fallback paths when batch sizes collapse.
AlexC: Uploading quick flame link: https://intra.redwood/profiles/1763456789/flame.svg (summary: ~48% in kv_get(), ~22% in cudaMalloc/backoff, ~12% in attention_kernels::fused_softmax fallback).
RyanK: Interesting — batching heuristics are relevant. When KV misses spike, generation latency increases per request which reduces reactor batching. Small batches + short seq -> selector sometimes picks the generic kernel (worse perf). pprof excerpt: `samples by function: kv_get 4800, cudaMalloc_wait 2200, fused_softmax_generic 1200`.
Samir: This matches previous 'thrash' pattern: one tenant issues lots of small context lookups, keeps evicting shared KV entries, causes cache fill churn -> memory pressure -> cuda alloc latency jumps.
Marta: Two routes: short-term mitigation (throttle tenant, bump cache, pin tenant) vs long-term changes (kernel selector preference + batching pad/join). We should reproduce before deciding.
ops-bot: Pool snapshot at 02:16Z: 16 GPUs in pool-p2-shared, 28 active tenants, avg GPU util 63%. No per-tenant concurrency caps configured for T-42.
AlexC: Quick test: increased KV cache size by 25% on node-3 at 02:22Z — eviction_rate dropped from 4.3/s -> 1.1/s and p95 fell from 1.1s -> 340ms. But global GPU memory headroom decreased noticeably. Not safe long-term.
RyanK: Proposed perf patch: (1) prefer optimized small-seq kernels when batch size <= 4 even if current heuristics suggest fallback, (2) introduce a cheap prebatcher that coalesces micro-requests into a synthetic batch for kernel selection stage. Prototype should be low-risk.
Marta: Also add observability: per-tenant kv_hotness metric + alert when eviction_rate > 1/s sustained for 30s. Then auto-soft-quota the hot tenant.
Samir: Immediate operations mitigation: set tenant T-42 max_concurrency=6 and enable quantized-model fallback for them to reduce GPU memory churn. That should be safe for an hour while we validate.
AlexC: Opening PR/issue for mitigation: https://gh.redwood/ops/issues/PROF-789. I'll run controlled replay with T-42 load tonight and post perf diffs.
perf-bot: Heap snapshot (02:20Z): transient GPU alloc spikes align with KV refill windows; top alloc callstacks show cudaMalloc on model cache miss path.
RyanK: Will prototype kernel selector diff and run replay. Expect to have microbench numbers by tomorrow morning.
Marta: Thanks — once Ryan's diff lands, let's run a canary on a single GPU in the shared pool, and keep per-tenant caps on until we have quota heuristics.
AlexC: Agreed. I'll coordinate the canary and update the issue with timestamps and links to traces.
Samir: If helpful I can create an automated job to inject KV miss load for safe repro.
RyanK: :thumbsup: scheduling that job now on ci-perf and will post results.`
